name: MACH 1 Soccer Camps
description_short: Indoor, air-conditioned soccer day camps run by MACH 1 Futbol Club at Wide World of Indoor Sports in North Smithfield, RI. Younger players (U6-U8) attend a half day (9:00-12:00). Older players (U7-U11 and U12-U14) attend a full day (9:00-3:30) of skills and tactics training.

warnings: This one listing covers two locations. North Smithfield, RI (621 Pound Hill Rd, 02896) is recorded as the main address. The Montville, CT sessions are held at Wide World of Indoor Sports, 2 Satchatello Industrial Dr, Montville, CT 06370.
Registration status conflicts: the page says Summer 2027 'registrations opening soon', but each session link is labeled 'REGISTRATION OPEN'. All sessions are set to unknown availability.
The Montville section heading still says 'SUMMER 2026 – MONTVILLE, CT', but its session dates are for 2027.
The early-bird discounts differ by location: $25 in North Smithfield and $30 in Montville, both for full-day registrations paid before 12/31/2026.
Early drop-off time differs by location: 7:30 AM in North Smithfield and 8:00 AM in Montville. Late pickup is until 5 PM at both, and each option is $40 per week.
Session prices are left blank because every week has two options: $279 for a full day or $179 for a half day.
The age groups are given as birth-date ranges, and they overlap: U6-U8 covers 8/1/2018–7/31/2021 and U7-U11 covers 8/1/2015–7/31/2020. These ranges may not have been updated for 2027.
The North Smithfield week of July 5, 2027 falls on the observed Independence Day holiday (July 4 is a Sunday).
Each session has its own GotSport registration link, so no single registration URL is recorded. Example: https://system.gotsport.com/programs/506Y37670?reg_role=player
unknowns: Exact ages for each group (the page gives only birth-date ranges, and they overlap)

changes: Removed the three Montville, CT sessions: Montville is about 55 miles from Providence, outside the area, and is a different location from this listing's North Smithfield address.
Description no longer mentions Montville. Kept the four 2027 North Smithfield weeks, $179-$279/week and extended care ($40/week early drop-off or late pickup).
